name: Marquis
description: The first test for most samples. Reacts with MDMA, opioids and amphetamines; cocaine gives no reaction.

name: Mecke
description: Helps tell opioids and MDMA-family drugs apart.

name: Mandelin
description: Useful for ketamine, which gives no reaction on Marquis.

name: Simon's
description: Detects secondary amines, which separates MDMA from MDA and methamphetamine from amphetamine.
